name: Hemispherical Fibonacci AO Sample Generation
definition: Generates a set of 3D direction vectors for ambient occlusion sampling using a hemispherical Fibonacci mapping, stored in a compute buffer.
summary: Hemispherical Fibonacci AO Sample Generation creates deterministic, uniformly distributed 3D direction vectors for screen-space ambient occlusion using a Fibonacci lattice, differing from quadratic scale sampling by ensuring consistent hemisphere coverage.
